The system keeps complaining about parsing error. Possibly need to ensure proper JSON formatting: no extra spaces? The tags must be exactly <thought>...</thought> etc. The action_input must be a JSON object, not a string with extra quotes. So we need:

<action_input>{"route":"{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"CCCC(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1\",\"children\":[{\"type\":\"reaction\",\"template_id\":80382,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"C=Cc1ccccc1C=C\"},{\"type\":\"mol\",\"smiles\":\"CCCC(=O)Cl\"}]}]}"} </action_input>

Make sure no trailing spaces before closing tag. Let's try.
